textSegments: Hydro GSM Lite PRO | Power Supplies (PSU) | FSP
Compliance with the newest ATX 12V V2.52
Full protections OCP, OVP, SCP, OPP, OTP
Sophisticated and User-Friendly for Fan and Design
Hydro GSM LITE PRO series is mounted with an octagonal stainless fan grill to form an excellent airflow for optimal cooling. The surface is coated with matte black finish to prevent any scratches.
The LLC topology allows for zero voltage switching of the main stitches thereby dramatically lowering switching losses and boosting efficiency.
Both of +3.3V and +5V DC-DC module combined +12VSR circuit offers supreme efficiency, voltage stability, and high system compatibility especially in cross regulation (unbalance load) mode.
Hydro GSM Lite PRO series uses  Japanese electrolytic capacitors to ensure a longer lifetime, especially main-capacitor adopting 450V voltage durability to protect your PSU from sudden power change!
The all black coating flat cables give Hydro GSM LITE PRO series a stylish and quality look.
Dual CPU power connectors support high-end MB and deliver stable power to your CPU.
The Hydro GSM LITE PRO series is designed to be semi-modular, which not only saves the user time during installation but also provides your system with a neat and tidy look for cable management.
Powerful +12V Single Rail for your VGA

VGA card is a component which requires stable power. The Hydro GSM LITE PRO series comes with a single +12V rail design that offers VGA cards full power individually and avoids any overloading conditions.
Hydro GSM Lite PRO series is a power supply with 80 PLUS® Gold Certification that guarantees to operate at a minimum of 90% efficiency at 50% load of PSU rated power and reduces electricity cost.
